object_name: Classic tripod floor lamp with twisted black metal stand and beige fabric shade

components.name: central_lower_stem
components.description: Slender vertical black metal cylinder centered at the origin, approximately 0.035 units in diameter, extending from z=0.12 to z=0.78. This is the main structural shaft above the tripod base.

components.name: decorative_twist
components.description: Middle ornamental section spanning approximately z=0.78 to z=1.18. Model as two or three thin black metal rods winding visually around the central vertical axis, using a sequence of short cylinders between points sampled along opposing helical paths. Keep the overall twist narrow, with a maximum diameter near 0.10, and preserve a refined open-metal appearance.

components.name: central_upper_stem
components.description: Straight slender black metal cylinder aligned with the lower stem, extending from the top of the decorative twist at about z=1.18 to the shade support at about z=1.47. Match the lower stem diameter and finish.

components.name: tripod_hub
components.description: Compact black metal connector around the stem near z=0.18. Use a short vertical cylinder or sphere-like joint, roughly 0.10 in diameter, from which the three legs spread.

components.name: curved_tripod_legs
components.description: Three identical black metal legs arranged radially at 120-degree intervals around the vertical axis. Each leg begins at the tripod hub, bends smoothly outward and downward, and ends on the floor at z=0 with foot centers approximately 0.30 to 0.34 from the axis. Approximate each curve with 3 to 5 connected cylindrical segments, keeping the legs thin, elegant, and symmetric.

components.name: feet
components.description: Three small flattened black pads or short cylinders at the ends of the tripod legs. Each pad rests flush on z=0 and is aligned beneath its corresponding leg endpoint.

components.name: lamp_socket
components.description: Small dark socket assembly centered above the upper stem, approximately 0.07 in diameter and 0.12 high, spanning roughly z=1.45 to z=1.57. It should be mostly concealed by the shade.

components.name: lampshade_frame
components.description: Thin dark upper and lower circular support rings centered on the lamp axis. The upper ring is near z=1.72 with radius about 0.18; the lower ring is near z=1.42 with radius about 0.31. Approximate each ring using many short tangent-aligned cylinders arranged radially.

components.name: fabric_lampshade
components.description: Soft light beige tapered shade centered on the vertical axis, approximately 0.34 high, with a narrower top radius around 0.18 and a wider bottom radius around 0.31. Since no cone primitive is available, construct the shade from 8 to 12 shallow stacked cylinders whose radii increase gradually from top to bottom. Use a warm light beige color and slight transparency if supported, while keeping the stepped profile subtle.

components.name: shade_trim
components.description: Narrow beige or slightly darker cream bands around the top and bottom edges of the lampshade, represented by very shallow cylinders. These bands visually finish the fabric shade and reinforce its classic style.

relations: Use world coordinates with +z upward; place the lamp upright and centered around x=0, y=0.
The three feet define the ground contact plane at z=0, and no other lamp geometry should extend below this plane.
The lower stem, decorative twist, upper stem, socket, and lampshade are coaxial on the world z-axis.
Attach the tripod hub around the lower portion of the central stem, with all three legs structurally radiating from this hub.
Arrange the curved legs with radial symmetry at angles 0, 120, and 240 degrees around +z. Each leg must curve outward as it descends and terminate at the same radial distance and floor height.
Construct every curved leg as a continuous chain of endpoint-connected cylinders; neighboring segments should overlap slightly so no gaps are visible.
The decorative twist replaces or surrounds the middle section of the straight stem and must connect visually to both the lower and upper straight stem sections.
For the twist, use matching helical paths offset by 180 degrees so the rods cross around the axis without creating a bulky central mass.
Place the socket directly on top of the upper stem and center the shade around it.
The lampshade bottom should overlap the socket region vertically, concealing most of the electrical support while leaving the shade visibly elevated above the decorative twist.
Stack the lampshade slices with no vertical gaps and monotonically increasing radius toward the bottom to create a coherent truncated-cone silhouette.
Keep the broad lower shade centered above the tripod footprint; its radius may be similar to but should not substantially exceed the foot radius.
Use a consistent matte or satin black appearance for all metal parts, contrasted with a warm light beige fabric shade.
Overall target proportions are approximately 1.75 units tall, 0.62 units wide at the shade, and 0.60 to 0.68 units across the tripod feet.
critic_checklist: The completed object is unmistakably a tall floor lamp rather than a table lamp.
The total height is approximately 1.7 to 1.8 units, with a slender vertical profile.
Exactly three supporting legs are present and distributed evenly at 120-degree intervals.
All three feet touch z=0 and provide a stable, symmetric tripod footprint.
Each leg visibly curves or bends outward from the central hub rather than appearing as one straight radial bar.
The primary stand is thin and black, with no oversized shaft sections.
A clearly visible decorative twisted metal section occupies the middle region of the stand.
The twist is narrow, open, symmetric around the central axis, and continuously connected to the straight stem above and below.
The socket and shade are centered on the same vertical axis as the stand.
The shade has a light beige fabric-like appearance and a wider bottom than top.
The shade profile reads as one continuous tapered form despite being assembled from stacked cylindrical slices.
There are no visible gaps between shade slices, leg segments, stem sections, or twist segments.
The lampshade is the dominant upper feature, while the tripod base is the dominant lower feature.
The lower edge of the shade is level and horizontal; the lamp does not appear tilted.
Black metal components and warm beige shade provide a clear classic, elegant material contrast.
No geometry penetrates below the floor, and no detached or floating components are present.
